title: Slow Cooker Balsamic Chicken
description: Balsamic chicken breasts in the slow cooker are so easy and delicious, they're bound to become a family favorite. So easy and so good.
ingredients: 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Drizzle olive oil into the slow cooker. Place chicken breasts on top of oil and season each breast with salt and pepper. Top chicken breasts with onion slices, garlic, oregano, basil, rosemary, and thyme. Drizzle balsamic vinegar over seasoned breasts and pour tomatoes on top.
Cook in the slow cooker set to High until chicken is no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 4 hours.

video.description: For the recipe in this video, the sauce is not thick, it is a bit runny, but very tasty. Add tomato paste if you want it thicker. Serve on top of pasta and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, and use one can of crushed tomatoes and one can of diced tomatoes.
